Title: Azure HDInsight for Apache Spark 3.3 is now available for public preview

Body.Content: Apache Spark™ 3.3 on HDInsight is now in public preview. The essential changes include features which come from upgrading Apache Spark to version 3.3.1. Check out the official release notes for Apache Spark 3.3.0 and Apache Spark 3.3.1
